$comment: THE declaration of omx-delay, the folder's one hand-written file. Every other file of the folder is generated from it by tools/gen.mjs. Its parameters are by reference to omx-contract's delay kernel and bind by name to omx-dsp's instance face. Parameter order is append-only.
name: omx delay
description: The OpenMixer console's stereo delay: one time, feedback through a tone filter, ping-pong and a wet/dry mix.
summary: Stereo delay up to 2 s: feedback through a tone filter that darkens each repeat, ping-pong, wet/dry mix. Zero latency, real-time safe, 44.1 to 192 kHz.
manual: | Time | 0 to 2000 ms, whole ms | 300 ms |
Plus the host's bypass. The tone filter holds the same corner at every sample rate, so a session
moved from 48 to 96 kHz sounds the same.
